sentences.en: Political concerns have caused many people to doubt the prediction.
sentences.zh: 政治因素让很多人对预测产生了怀疑。

sentences.en: Marcus's prediction was spot on, as the results now show.
sentences.zh: 马库斯的预测完全正确，现在的结果证明了这一点。

sentences.en: I'm afraid your prediction was wide of the mark.
sentences.zh: 恐怕你的预测有些偏差。

senses.zh: 预言之事，预报之事；预测（行为）
